SELECT candidate_face_encrypted_ref, source_type, compared_at FROM ( SELECT candidate_face_encrypted_ref, 'MOBILE_CHANGE' AS source_type, COALESCE(promoted_at, created_at) AS compared_at FROM user_mobile_change_face_verification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PROMOTED' AND candidate_face_encrypted_ref IS NOT NULL AND candidate_face_encrypted_ref <> ''
UNION ALL
SELECT candidate_face_encrypted_ref, 'DEVICE_SWITCH_LOGIN' AS source_type, COALESCE(consumed_at, created_at) AS compared_at FROM user_device_switch_face_verification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'CONSUMED' AND candidate_face_encrypted_ref IS NOT NULL AND candidate_face_encrypted_ref <> ''
UNION ALL
SELECT candidate_face_encrypted_ref, 'BANK_CARD_ADD' AS source_type, COALESCE(consumed_at, created_at) AS compared_at FROM user_bank_card_add_face_verification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'CONSUMED' AND candidate_face_encrypted_ref IS NOT NULL AND candidate_face_encrypted_ref <> '' ) recent_success ORDER BY compared_at DESC LIMIT 1
